ir.name: pairwise_smooth_margin_loss_varnorm_adaptive_scale_normalized
ir.intuition: Inject an explicit normalization constraint by normalizing the weighted loss sum by the total weight, ensuring loss scale is invariant to varying total sample weights and stabilizing training especially when weights vary dynamically.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-6
var_adv = ops.mean((advantage_gap - ops.mean(advantage_gap))**2) + eps
var_rank = ops.mean((delta_rank - ops.mean(delta_rank))**2) + eps
inv_var = 1.0 / (var_adv + var_rank)
adv_norm = advantage_gap / var_adv
rank_norm = delta_rank / var_rank

rank_scaled = ops.tanh(rank_norm) * margin_rank
margin = adv_scaled + rank_scaled
adaptive_scale = scale * inv_var

loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x) * weight
loss = loss.sum() / (weight.sum() + eps)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    delta_r = batch['delta_rank']
    weight = batch['weight']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.2))
    margin_adv = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin_adv', 0.05))
    margin_rank = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin_rank', 0.02))
    eps = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('eps', 1e-6))

    mean_adv = ops.mean(adv_gap)
    mean_rank = ops.mean(delta_r)

    var_adv = ops.mean((adv_gap - mean_adv) * (adv_gap - mean_adv)) + eps
    var_rank = ops.mean((delta_r - mean_rank) * (delta_r - mean_rank)) + eps
    inv_var = 1.0 / (var_adv + var_rank)

    adv_normed = adv_gap / var_adv
    rank_normed = delta_r / var_rank

    adv_scaled = ops.sigmoid(adv_normed) * margin_adv
    rank_scaled = ops.tanh(rank_normed) * margin_rank
    margin = adv_scaled + rank_scaled

    adaptive_scale = scale * inv_var

    x = alpha * adaptive_scale * (lpw - lpl) - margin

    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x) * weight
    return loss.sum() / (weight.sum() + eps)
